jobs.description:
As a production worker, you're the driving force behind the production process. You ensure the production line always runs smoothly by replenishing and trimming meat as needed. Don't worry if you don't have experience with knives – you'll learn! You'll also help load and unload trucks and work in various departments, such as production, packaging, and shipping. No two days are the same for a production worker, and that's what makes it so rewarding.
We're looking for a production worker who's a hands-on person.

You're physically fit, speak fluent Dutch or English, and enjoy working independently and as part of a team. As a production worker, you take responsibility, remain calm under pressure, and prioritize effectively.

Flexibility is key: you'll start between 3:30 and 6:30 a.m. and work until everything is finished, OR you'll work in two shifts: from 3:30 a.m. to 1:30 p.m. and the other week from 1:30 p.m. to 10:30 p.m.

Working in a refrigerated environment? No problem for you!

 

Eager to get stuck in? Then you're the production worker we want on our team!

Where Italian nostalgia meets real hospitality leadership
 

Nando isn't just another restaurant, it's Nonna's kitchen, brought to life in Wilrijk, Antwerp. Retro details, honest Italian comfort food, and a room that feels like family. We're looking for a 
Waiter / Service Responsible to own the floor: someone who leads by example during service, keeps the room running like clockwork, and makes sure every guest leaves feeling like they just had dinner at home.
 

What you'll do
 
 

• Welcome guests and set the tone for the evening 

• Take orders and serve with precision, even when it's slammed 

• Own the floor during service — pace, table turns, team energy, guest happiness 

• Coach and steady the team in real time; step in and solve problems before guests notice them 

• Be the calm, capable presence management can count on when it gets busy  

What you bring
 
 

• Experience as a waiter or shift leader in hospitality 

• A natural feel for service and a bit of leadership instinct 

• Composure under pressure — busy nights don't rattle you 

• Organized, hands-on, solutions over excuses 

• English (required), basic Dutch (required); Italian or French is a real plus  

What's in it for you
 
 

• Full-time, 38h contract 

• €16.00–€18.00 brutto/hour, negotiable based on experience 

• Meal vouchers, holiday pay, and a 13th month 

• Bike allowance and uniform provided 

• Real responsibility on the floor from day one — with a clear path to become manager within your first 6 to 12 months 

• Room to grow within a restaurant group that's expanding  

Restaurant is open 7/7, with 2 days off per week.
 

 Send your CV, a photo, and a short intro to 
hr@lvpgroup.be — tell us why Nando feels like your kind of room.

As a Team Leader within the logistics department, you are responsible for leading and supporting a team of warehouse employees, with a focus on the efficient handling, storage, and distribution of goods. You ensure that operational targets are achieved and that safety and quality standards are consistently followed.

The role consists of four key areas of responsibility. In addition, you are willing to work operationally alongside your team when necessary.

 
• 
Team Leadership: Train, manage, motivate, and support your team to achieve operational targets, while identifying training and development needs.

 
• 
Operational Management: Monitor workflows related to the receipt, storage, picking, packing, and shipment of parts.

 
• 
Performance & Reporting: Monitor team performance and results and report these to the Supervisor.

 
• 
Problem Solving: Resolve minor operational issues and escalate more complex problems when necessary.

 
• 
Strong leadership and people management skills.

 
• 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

 
• 
Excellent command of the English language.

 
• 
Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking skills.

 
• 
Strong attention to detail and commitment to quality.

 
• 
Ability to work under pressure and adapt to changing priorities.

 
• 
Experience in warehouse management or a similar role, preferably within the automotive sector.

For our client in the food industry, located in the Oudenaarde region, we are looking for an Order Picker who is willing to work in a 3-shift system.

Your responsibilities 

 
• You collect products from the cold and hot production lines and store them in the correct location in the refrigerator. 
 
• You label products correctly and register batch numbers, expiry dates and returnable packaging in MAPA. 
 
• You monitor stock levels and report shortages in a timely manner. 
 
• You check incoming deliveries for quantity, temperature and condition, and register the information in MAPA. 
 
• You assist drivers with loading and unloading and correctly apply the FIFO principle. 
 
• You keep the warehouse, refrigerators and loading bays clean and tidy and ensure that returnable packaging is stored in the correct location. 
 
• You work an early, day or late shift – working hours vary depending on the schedule and the day. 

What are we looking for in an Order Picker?

 

 
• You have a good command of English. 
 
• You are comfortable working in a chilled environment of approximately 7°C. 
 
• You can operate an electric pallet truck and a reach truck. 
 
• You are flexible and available to work early, day and late shifts, including occasional Saturdays or Sundays. 
 
• You work accurately: quantities, temperatures, batch numbers and expiry dates must be correct. 
 
• You are able to maintain an overview when several orders need to be prepared at the same time and can determine which tasks should be given priority.

CLdN is an international logistics player with a strong European network and a clear focus on efficient and sustainable maritime connections. For CLdN RoRo Agencies NV in Zeebrugge, we are looking for a motivated Customs & Border Compliance Officer for the logistics department.
 

JOB DESCRIPTION
 

As a Customs & Border Compliance Officer, you will follow up on all customs and compliance activities within Shipping, Port and Door-to-Door processes. You act as the link between internal teams, customers and authorities, ensuring a smooth and compliant flow of goods.
 
 

• Manage customs formalities and ensure compliance with applicable legislation. 

• Apply for and follow up on permits (AEO, bonded warehouse, temporary storage, …) and liaise with 

customs and port authorities. 

• Act as the point of contact for customs-related matters and support internal and external stakeholders. 

• Prepare and improve procedures, KPIs and reporting. 

• Optimize processes and resolve operational issues. 

PROFILE
 
 

• You have a very good command of Dutch and English; additional languages are a plus. 

• You preferably have a Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics or a related field, with some exposure to customs, or are willing to quickly develop this expertise. 

• You preferably have experience or knowledge in customs, shipping or port operations, or are willing to quickly develop this expertise. 

• You are eager to learn and able to quickly process and master a large amount of complex information and legislation. 

• You have a hands-on mentality and strong problem-solving skills. 

• You possess excellent communication skills and easily build relationships with internal and external stakeholders. 

• You are willing to participate in an on-call rotation (approximately every 12 weeks, including weekends/evenings).

Job description
 

● As a Project and Engineering Manager - BESS you’ll drive the engineering and 

execution of major BESS projects (typically >100M EUR investment).
 

● You are responsible for overseeing multidisciplinary design across electrical, civil, 

and structural engineering domains..
 

● You supervise EPC partners, engineering firms, consultants, and other external 

stakeholders throughout all phases, and coordinate internal teams including 

development, procurement, construction, and HSE.
 

● As a Project and Engineering Manager - BESS you prepare technical specifications 

and lead tendering processes with suppliers, integrators, and contractors..
 

● You manage key technical domains such as: BESS system architecture, HV/MV 

substations, grid interconnection, cabling, electrical infrastructure, civil works, site 

infrastructure, etc.
 

● As a Project and Engineering Manager - BESS you closely follow the project 

planning, make adjustments where necessary, and report on the project progress 

and the milestones.

Your profile
 

● You have a Master degree in Engineering (Electrical, Industrial, Civil, …) or 

equivalent level of education.
 

● You have relevant experience in engineering or construction of large-scale energy or 

infrastructure projects (BESS or renewables preferred).
 

● Solid understanding of project development, permitting, and grid connection 

procedures.
 

● You have strong coordinating skills and are able of successfully managing all parties 

involved.
 

● Excellent knowledge of English and French, able to communicate in Dutch is a plus.
 

● You are communicative, have strong people skills and can take initiative.

Let's Work is recruiting a production technician to work two shifts for an international market leader in Roeselare.

As a Production Technician, you will provide technical support within an automated production environment, with a 50/50 split between mechanical and electrical work. You will troubleshoot, analyse and resolve technical faults on a varied range of machinery, including CNC machines, robots, milling and sawing machines, while also carrying out preventive maintenance and implementing improvements together with the Technical Manager. You'll receive an attractive salary supplemented by meal vouchers, as well as thorough training and ongoing support in a modern working environment where safety, wellbeing and teamwork are key.

Do you get a kick out of tackling technical faults quickly and do you enjoy working with a varied and automated range of machinery? Then be sure to read on!

What will your tasks involve?

 
• 
You will identify, analyse and pragmatically resolve technical faults in the machinery so that production can resume quickly

 
• 
Following technical interventions, you document the work carried out and the solutions implemented

 
• 
You carry out preventive maintenance in accordance with the existing maintenance plan

 
• 
Together with the Technical Manager, you'll develop ideas for improvements and ensure their practical implementation

 
• 
Within the machinery fleet, you'll work with CNC machines, milling and sawing machines, handling and pick & place robots, and welding robots

 
• 
When technical problems arise, you take independent responsibility and actively seek a workable solution

 
• 
A technical qualification with prior experience in electromechanics forms the basis for this role

 
• 
Experience within an industrial production environment is important, preferably with CNC, robots, fully automated production lines and machine maintenance

 
• 
Knowledge of motors and gearboxes, compressed air, hydraulics, electricity and HMI is very useful

 
• 
Experience with welding is essential; a VCA certificate and a forklift or aerial work platform licence are an advantage

 
• 
Fluency in English is important for internal communication on the shop floor. You should also be comfortable using basic PC applications

 
• 
You are hands-on, independent, keen to learn and results-oriented and attach great importance to 5S and the safe handling of valuable equipment

Responsibilities

In this role as a Python ERP Developer, you take charge of the continuous evolution of internal business applications.

• Develop and refine custom features within the Odoo platform to streamline core operational processes.

• Troubleshoot technical issues quickly to maintain smooth daily workflows or coordinate with external development partners.

Profile

For the position of Python ERP Developer, we are looking for a developer with a few years under their belt who combines analytical thinking with clear communication skills.

• Proven proficiency in Python and familiarity with other programming languages like .NET (ideally 2 to 4 years of experience in a similar role).
• Demonstrable experience with Odoo or a comparable ERP package is a major advantage.

jobs.occupation: Finance Officer | Mandarin & English | International group
jobs.description:
Are you a 
Finance professional with experience in Belgian accounting and a strong interest in an international environment? Do you speak 
Mandarin and English and enjoy acting as the link between different finance teams? Are you looking for a role where you can combine your accounting knowledge with 
international collaboration, communication and coaching?
 

 
 

You will join a 
dynamic international industrial group with activities across different markets and a strong presence in both Europe and Asia. Despite its international scale, the organisation maintains 
short communication lines and a personal, family-oriented approach. You will become an important link between the finance team in the 
Waregem region and the finance team in China, giving you a unique opportunity to work across cultures and finance environments.
 

 
 

About the company
 

The organisation is part of a 
large international industrial group with activities across multiple countries. The Belgian organisation operates in a 
dynamic and entrepreneurial environment where collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement are encouraged. You will work closely with colleagues in Belgium and China and play an important role in ensuring smooth communication between both finance teams.
 

 
 

Your responsibilities as Finance Officer:
 
 

• You follow up on 
purchase and sales invoices, payments and outstanding items and ensure that the Belgian finance administration is processed accurately and on time. 
This gives you a hands-on role with direct ownership of important accounting processes. 

• You perform and monitor 
bank bookings and financial transactions, while keeping the accounting records accurate and up to date. 
You will further strengthen your practical accounting expertise within an international environment. 

• You act as the 
financial point of contact between the Belgian site and the finance team in China, translating questions, clarifying processes and ensuring that information flows smoothly between both locations. 
This gives you broad international exposure and allows you to build a strong network across two finance organisations. 

• You support and 
coach finance colleagues in China on Belgian accounting principles, processes and reporting requirements. 
You can use your own experience to help colleagues develop while simultaneously strengthening your communication and coordination skills. 

• You will occasionally 
travel to China to strengthen collaboration with the local finance team and support the alignment of processes. 
This offers you valuable international experience and the opportunity to work directly with colleagues on-site.  

 
 

Profile requirements as Finance Officer:
 
 

• You have practical experience within 
Belgian accounting and are familiar with 
BE GAAP. 

• You speak 
Mandarin Chinese and English fluently, allowing you to communicate effectively with both the Belgian and Chinese finance teams. 

• Knowledge of 
Dutch is a nice-to-have. 

• You are comfortable working in an international and multicultural environment. 

• You have a 
coordinating and communicative personality and enjoy acting as a bridge between different teams. 

• You are willing to 
travel to China occasionally as part of your role.

jobs.occupation: CONSULTANT REGULATORY AFFAIRS Biocides, junior or medior
jobs.description:
Ensus Consulting BV is a consulting and services firm operating at the interface between science, government and industry. We provide tailor-made Regulatory Affairs dossier management services to national and international customers covering all aspects of dossiers related to chemicals legislations including the Biocidal Products Regulation (BPR), Plant Protection Products Regulation (PPPR), etc. In order to further expand our small regulatory affairs team, we are looking for a highly motivated new colleague.
 

After an initial period of training on-the-job, you will soon be expected to work independently. You will support companies in their regulatory challenges related to chemical products, incl. biocides and pesticides. You coordinate and support regulatory dossiers —covering both national and European chemical legislations— from start to finish. The latter includes for example setting up challenging efficacy testing scenarios, discussions with laboratories on analytical testing, dossier creation, etc. Furthermore, you will be able to take part to European discussions on drafting the guidance and commenting on existing guidance documents.
 

While we strongly value the capacity to work independently, it is also essential to cooperate with your colleagues, external partners and experts, authorities and our (inter)national customers.

The ideal candidate should:
 

be a (recent) graduate (Master or PhD level) in a life sciences discipline (chemistry, biology, biosciences, bioengineering, …).
 

be eager to develop expertise in the main aspects involved in dossier preparation: analytical chemistry, microbiology, (eco)toxicology, exposure assessment, risk assessment, modelling, classification and labelling, ...
 

preferably have relevant experience in research projects, through internships or industry trainee programmes. While demonstrated experience in executing regulatory projects (BPR, PPPR, CLP, … ) would be beneficial, it is not strictly required.
